_comment: Which roles may perform each action. Role names are matched case-insensitively. Edit this file to change permissions - no code change needed.
_dashboard_write: May edit shots, statuses and assignments on the dashboard.
_excel_sync: May import from and export to the project Excel backup.
_force_save: May overwrite another user's concurrent edit when a conflict is reported.
_artist_own_status: May set the status of a department row they are personally assigned to, and nothing else.
_artist_statuses: Statuses somebody with only artist_own_status may set. Everything else (Approved, Retake, Omit) is a verdict and stays with the roles in dashboard_write.
_department_scoped: Roles in dashboard_write that may edit only their own department's columns. The department comes from the person's job title.
_manage_leave: Works the leave approval queue at the HR stage, keeps the holiday calendar and closes the leave year.
_manage_it: Works the IT service desk and the IT half of joining and leaving.
_manage_users: Creates, edits and deletes user accounts on the Users & Roles tab.
_view_team_attendance: Sees the whole team's attendance grid, corrects punches and exports timesheets.
_ingest_stock: Ingests into and deletes from the stock library.
_wipe_fleet_caches: Clears thumbnail and proxy caches on every connected workstation.
